h1: Custom Gold Caps for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom gold caps in bulk for your team or event. Perfect Imprints offers quality decoration options.
introHtml: Gold caps offer a distinctive look that stands out from standard headwear. Whether you need embroidered gold caps for a sales team or a promotional giveaway at a trade show, the metallic sheen adds a premium feel. Choose from structured or unstructured styles and decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a crisp, lasting logo.
heroAltText: Custom gold caps with embroidered logo on front, structured fit, and curved brim
